fields.name: ReaderIds
fields.description: Server-stamped ACL: IAM user ids that may read the row.

fields.name: CreatedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the creating actor, set by the function.

fields.name: UpdatedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the last writer.

fields.name: Kind
fields.description: What the business agent found. One of: mustHave|workflow|exclusion|constraint|goal|users.

fields.name: Text
fields.description: The finding in plain words (as the setup would store it).

fields.name: Priority
fields.description: A must-have's priority. One of: must|should|could.

fields.name: SourceName
fields.description: Name of the document or note it was found in.

fields.name: SourceRef
fields.description: Where it was found: DocFile:<ItemId> or DocNote:<ItemId>.

fields.name: Key
fields.description: Kind and a hash of the folded text; one row per finding and project.

fields.name: SortOrder
fields.description: Order of the findings in the review.

fields.name: EngineJobId
fields.description: ItemId of the setup.assist EngineJob that found it.

fields.name: DecidedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the decider.

fields.name: RequestKey
fields.description: Idempotency key <op>:<requestId>[:<n>], set by the server; unique index.
